target_pattern: Differentiate saber (facts, information, skills), saber cómo (method/process), and conocer (familiarity with people/places/things), including personal a with people.

cognitive_shift.english_trap: Translating every know as one verb.
cognitive_shift.spanish_logic: Spanish splits know by meaning: saber for facts/skills, conocer for familiarity, and saber cómo for process.
natural_examples: Sé cocinar, pero no sé cómo hacer paella.

controlled_recombination.instructions: Write each in Spanish using saber, saber cómo, or conocer naturally. No answer key until the end.
prompts_en: Do you know Juan?
Do you want to meet Juan?
Can I meet Juan?
Do you know how to swim?
Do you know how to write in Spanish?
Do you know where the bathroom is?
Do you know if María has to work tomorrow?
I know how to cook.
I do not know how to start.
Do you know how to explain this process?
I know this city very well.
Do you know my sister Ana?
We know a good restaurant near here.
I do not know the answer.
Do you know the movie Coco?
I know how to drive, but I do not know this area.
Do you know who she is?
I have to meet this person.
We do not know how to get to the office.
Do you know if they can come today?

pattern_mutation.instructions: Transform each base sentence as instructed.
drills: Base: ¿Conoces a Juan? -> change to first-person statement.
Base: Sé cocinar. -> make it negative.
Base: No sé cómo empezar. -> make it affirmative.
Base: ¿Sabes dónde está el hotel? -> change hotel to banco.
Base: Conozco la ciudad. -> make it negative.
Base: ¿Conoces a mi hermana? -> change to plural object mis hermanos.
Base: Sé hablar español. -> turn into question (tú).
Base: No conocemos ese restaurante. -> make it affirmative.
Base: ¿Sabes si Juan viene? -> change Juan to María.
Base: Sé cómo explicar esto. -> make it negative.
Base: ¿Quieres conocer a mi amigo? -> change to tengo que.
Base: No sé la respuesta. -> change to question form.
Base: Conozco la canción. -> change meaning to know the lyrics.
Base: Sabemos cómo llegar a la casa de Ana. -> change to singular yo.

contrastive_discrimination.instructions: Choose the most natural pattern and write in Spanish.
prompts: I know Juan. (sé vs conozco)
I know the answer. (sé vs conozco)
Do you know how to cook? (¿sabes cocinar? vs ¿conoces cocinar?)
Do you know how to solve this? method focus (sabes cómo vs sabes)
I know this city. (conozco vs sé)
Do you know where she is? (sabes dónde vs conoces dónde)
I know this movie. familiarity context (conozco vs sé)
I know the lyrics. factual content (sé vs conozco)
Do you know María? (conoces a vs sabes a)
I do not know how to begin. (no sé cómo empezar vs no conozco empezar)

common_errors.why_it_happens: English uses know for both meanings.

common_errors.mistake: Forgetting personal a with people after conocer
Overusing saber cómo for general skills
Using plain saber + infinitive when method is key
common_errors.why_it_happens: Method vs ability distinction is blurred.
Literal transfer from English clause logic.

common_errors.mistake: Wrong first person conjugation yo sabe
common_errors.why_it_happens: Irregular sé and conozco not automated.
Pattern confusion with modal + infinitive structures.

common_errors.mistake: Using saber for familiarity with city/movie
common_errors.why_it_happens: Facts and familiarity are not separated.
common_errors.correct_spanish: Conozco la ciudad / Conozco la película.
